continuity: Baek Yeon, once trusted by the late Emperor and a martial arts instructor to the Crown Prince, helped the fourth prince seize the throne and led the purge; Hong Jin says 30,000 people were arrested and killed.
Hong Jin was unable to detect or stop the coup and remains resolved to protect Prince Shangshan, both in fulfillment of the late Emperor’s final wish and out of personal devotion.
Prince Shangshan is thirteen and has already shown composure in the face of death and the ability to make Baek Yeon bow his head.
An unidentified guest has entered the pavilion at night, apparently brought there by Hong Jin without the Embroidered Uniform Guard noticing.
plot: After Prince Shangshan falls asleep, Hong Jin warns Jin Taekyung to keep his distance from Baek Yeon and reveals that Baek led the coup that put the fourth prince on the throne, betraying the late Emperor and Crown Prince and killing 30,000 people in the purge. Hong admits his determination to protect Shangshan is both the late Emperor’s final wish and a personal devotion; Taekyung argues that Shangshan is already a king, not merely a child to be protected. Hong has secretly brought an uninvited guest past the guards, and the stranger appears when the candles go out.
translation_decisions: Render 창위 as “Changwei,” the collective term for the East Depot and Embroidered Uniform Guard.
Render 혈사자 as “Blood Envoy,” Baek Yeon’s sobriquet.
